item.title: Scion of Democratic Politics Makes Runoff for Alaska Governor
item.description: Tom Begich, a former Democratic legislator and singer-songwriter, will be one of four candidates on the ranked-choice ballot for governor in November.

item.title: Progressive Democrat Makes Runoff for Alaska Governor

item.title: Mary Peltola and Dan Sullivan Advance in Key Alaska Senate Contest
item.description: The Democratic former congresswoman and the incumbent Republican senator will face off in November. Whether a potential spoiler candidate with the same name as the senator qualifies alongside them has not been determined.

item.media:description: Former Representative Mary Peltola, a Democrat, and Senator Dan Sullivan, a Republican, will advance to the general election for an Alaska Senate seat.

item.title: A Stunning Win for the Left in Florida: 6 Takeaways From Tuesday’s Primaries

item.media:description: State Representative Angie Nixon spent just $60,000 on television advertising, compared to opponent Alex Vindman’s $2.2 million.

item.title: 5 Things to Know About Mary Peltola, Democratic Senate Candidate in Alaska
item.description: The Alaska Native, who grew up along the Kuskokwim River near the Bering Sea and fished for salmon, is the leading Democrat in the nonpartisan primary race.

item.media:description: Mary Peltola won a special election to replace Don Young in Congress in 2022 and was elected to a full term later that year.

item.title: 5 Things to Know About Dan Sullivan, the Alaska Senator Seeking Re-election

item.title: ‘I’m Not That Informed on National Security,’ Graham Says in South Carolina Debate

item.media:description: Google has updated Gmail’s policy to allow political committees to more easily bypass its spam filter when sending emails for donations, allowing more political ads to land in inboxes.

item.title: Florida Primary Underscores State’s New Identity as a Republican Juggernaut

item.title: What to Watch in Tuesday’s Primary Elections in Alaska, Florida and Beyond
